description: This file defines middleware and utility functions for enforcing tenant-aware access control in an Express.js application, specifically for MongoDB interactions. It includes functions to filter queries, modify documents, and attach tenant context to requests.

methods.name: isMongooseQuery
methods.description: Checks if an object is a Mongoose query by verifying presence of 'where' or 'find' methods.

methods.name: filterObject
methods.description: Adds tenant_id property to an object if not present, based on tenantId.

methods.name: filterQuery
methods.description: Modifies a Mongoose query to include tenant_id filter if not already present.

methods.name: applyToAggregation
methods.description: Prepends a $match stage with tenant_id to an aggregation pipeline if not already present.

methods.name: stampCreate
methods.description: Sets tenant_id on a document before creation, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: tenantScopeEnforcer
methods.description: Express middleware that enforces tenant-aware access control, attaching helper functions to the request object.
